run_gen_icache_buster: run gen_icache_buster.py with --num_methods and --output_dir to generate ICacheBuster C++ source files
run_gen_icache_buster_with_splits: run gen_icache_buster.py with --num_splits to split generated C++ code into multiple compilation units
review_grouper: review the grouper function that chunks an iterable into groups of n using itertools.zip_longest
review_main: review the main function that generates ICacheBuster header and source files from command-line arguments
refactor_grouper: refactor the grouper function to handle edge cases where the last group merges with the previous group
